results.description: a half-wave rectifier: a source vi(t) = 10 sin(120*pi*t) V drives a single diode in series with a 2.2 kOhm load resistor to ground. Use 1N4001 diodes with a realistic .model card (not an ideal diode). Show several 60 Hz cycles in a transient analysis. Harness requirements: name the source's output node 'in' and the output node (top of the load) 'out'.

attempts.netlist:
Half-wave rectifier with 1N4001 diode
Vin in 0 SIN(0 10 60)
D1 in out D1N4001
Rload out 0 2.2k
.model D1N4001 D(IS=14.11n RS=0.03 BV=50 IBV=1u CJO=25.9p TT=5.7u N=1.98)

.control
tran 50u 50m
print v(in) v(out)
.endc

.end

results.description: a double diode clipping circuit: vi(t) = 5 sin(6280 t) V drives the output node through a 15 kOhm series resistor. From the output to ground there are two diode-plus-battery branches: one clips the positive half-cycle using a 1.5 V source (V1), the other clips the negative half-cycle using a second 1.5 V source (V2). Use 1N4001 diodes with a realistic .model card (not an ideal diode). Show a few cycles in a transient analysis. Harness requirements: name the input node 'in' and the output node 'out'.

attempts.netlist:
* Double diode clipping circuit with 1N4001 diodes
V1 in 0 SIN(0 5 1000)
Rs in out 15k
D1 out n1 D1N4001
Vb1 n1 0 DC 1.5
D2 n2 out D1N4001
Vb2 0 n2 DC 1.5

.model D1N4001 D(IS=14.11n RS=0.0627 BV=75 IBV=5u CJO=27.79p VJ=0.7 M=0.5 TT=5.8u N=1.45)

.control
tran 10u 4m
print v(in) v(out)
.endc

.end

spec_check.target: input peak = 5 V +/-2.0%; positive clip = 1.9 .. 2.3 V; negative clip = -2.3 .. -1.9 V

results.description: a diode clamping circuit: a 10 V peak-to-peak, 1000 Hz square wave with zero DC offset drives a 0.1 uF series capacitor to the output node; a 68 kOhm resistor and a diode go from the output node to ground. The diode is oriented so the output is clamped positive (the output waveform is shifted up so it sits almost entirely above 0 V). Use 1N4001 diodes with a realistic .model card (not an ideal diode). Run the transient long enough to reach steady state. Harness requirements: name the source's output node 'in' and the output node 'out'.

attempts.netlist:
* Diode clamping circuit - positive clamper using 1N4001
.control
    tran 1u 20m
    print v(in) v(out)
.endc

Vin in 0 PULSE(-5 5 0 1n 1n 0.5m 1m)
C1 in out 0.1u
R1 out 0 68k
D1 0 out 1N4001

.model 1N4001 D(IS=14.11n RS=0.036 N=1.7 BV=50 IBV=10u CJO=20p M=0.333 VJ=0.7 TT=5.76u)

.end

spec_check.target: input p-p = 10 V +/-2.0%; clamped low level = -1 .. -0.2 V; high level = 8.5 .. 10 V; average level = 3.8 .. 5.2 V
spec_check.measured: input p-p: 10 V (+0.0%); clamped low level: -0.4065 V; high level: 9.651 V; average level: 4.521 V

results.description: a full-wave bridge rectifier: a ground-referenced source vi(t) = 10 sin(120*pi*t) V drives a bridge of four diodes, and a 2.2 kOhm load resistor is connected across the bridge output (the load floats; neither end is ground). Use 1N4001 diodes with a realistic .model card (not an ideal diode). Show several 60 Hz cycles in a transient analysis. Harness requirements: name the source's output node 'in', the load's positive terminal node 'outp' and its negative terminal node 'outn'.

attempts.netlist:
Full-wave bridge rectifier with 1N4001 diodes and 2.2k floating load

Vi in 0 SIN(0 10 60 0 0 0)

D1 in outp D1N4001
D2 0 outp D1N4001
D3 outn in D1N4001
D4 outn 0 D1N4001

Rload outp outn 2.2k

.model D1N4001 D(IS=14.11n RS=0.036 BV=50 IBV=10u CJO=20p TT=5.7u N=1.7 EG=1.11 XTI=3)

.control
tran 20u 50m
print v(in) v(outp) v(outn) v(outp,outn)
.endc

.end

results.description: an inverting active low-pass filter with a passband gain of -10 (20 dB) and a -3 dB cutoff frequency of 1 kHz (within 5%), built around a 741-style op-amp modelled as a subcircuit with finite open-loop gain and bandwidth (not an ideal source), powered from +/-15 V; include an AC analysis. Harness requirements: name the input node 'in' and the output node 'out'; input source with AC magnitude 1.

attempts.netlist:
Inverting active low-pass filter with 741-style op-amp macromodel

.control
ac dec 20 1 1meg
print vdb(out)
print vp(out)
op
print v(out)
.endc

* Power supplies
Vcc vcc 0 DC 15
Vee vee 0 DC -15

* Input source (AC magnitude 1)
Vin in 0 DC 0 AC 1

* Feedback network: R1 (input resistor), Rf (feedback), Cf (across Rf for LPF)
R1 in n1 10k
Rf n1 out 100k
Cf n1 out 1.5915n

* Op-amp instance (741-style macromodel)
X1 0 n1 out vcc vee opamp741

* --- 741-style op-amp subcircuit ---
.subckt opamp741 inp inn out vcc vee
* Input stage: high input impedance, differential gain stage
Rin inp inn 2Meg
Egain net1 0 inp inn 200000
* Dominant pole (~5 Hz) to give ~1MHz unity-gain bandwidth
Rp net1 net2 1k
Cp net2 0 31.83u
* Output buffer stage with small output resistance
Ebuf net3 0 net2 0 1
Rout net3 out 75
* Simple output voltage clamping to supply rails (approx)
Dclamp1 out vcc dclamp
Dclamp2 vee out dclamp
.model dclamp D(Is=1e-14 Rs=1 N=1)
.ends opamp741

.end

spec_check.target: passband gain = 20 dB +/-2.5%; f(-3dB) = 1000 Hz +/-5.0%; |phase| at 10 Hz = 150 .. 210 deg
spec_check.measured: passband gain: 20 dB (-0.0%); f(-3dB): 987.8 Hz (-1.2%); |phase| at 10 Hz: 179.4 deg
